# PNG2SVG.IO

Free online PNG to SVG converter. Vectorizes PNG images into clean layered SVG, EPS, and DXF files entirely in the browser. No uploads, no sign-up, no watermarks.

## What it does

- Converts PNG (raster) images to SVG (vector) using client-side WebAssembly tracing
- Exports SVG, EPS, and DXF from every conversion, with one vector layer per color
- Adjustable settings: color count, detail, path smoothing, and corner rounding
- Batch queue: convert several PNGs in one session and download all as a ZIP

## Who it is for

- Crafters using Cricut Design Space or Silhouette Studio
- Laser cutter and CNC operators who need DXF files
- Designers and print shops who need EPS vectors
- Anyone who needs a logo or illustration scaled up without quality loss

## Key facts

- 100% client-side: PNG files never leave the user's device, nothing is uploaded
- Free with no account required and no watermarks on output
- SVG output uses clean layered paths, one layer per quantized color
- Large images are scaled so the longest side is 1000 pixels before tracing; files up to 25 MB are accepted
